displayName: Smart PR Review — GitHub & Azure DevOps PR Review with AI
description: Review GitHub and Azure DevOps pull requests inside VS Code: diffs, comments, suggestions and votes.
config.azureDevOpsHosts: Azure DevOps Server hosts (for example `tfs.contoso.com`). Only hosts listed here receive your Azure DevOps credentials.
viewContainer.title: Smart PR Review
welcome.signedOut:
Sign in to GitHub to review the pull requests of this repository.
[Sign In to GitHub](command:smartPrReview.signIn)
welcome.noRepository: Open a folder that contains a Git repository whose remote is on GitHub or Azure DevOps. Git must be installed.
welcome.unsupported: This repository's remote is not on GitHub or Azure DevOps. For Azure DevOps Server, add its host to the setting `smartPrReview.azureDevOps.hosts` and reload the window.
welcome.signedOutAzureDevOps:
Sign in to Azure DevOps to review the pull requests of this repository.
[Sign In with Microsoft](command:smartPrReview.signIn)
[Use a Personal Access Token](command:smartPrReview.setAzureDevOpsPat)
welcome.signedOutAzureDevOpsServer:
Azure DevOps Server needs a Personal Access Token with the Code (Read & Write) scope.
[Enter Personal Access Token](command:smartPrReview.setAzureDevOpsPat)
command.setAzureDevOpsPat: Set Azure DevOps Personal Access Token
config.allowApproval: Offer the approving votes (*Approve*, and on Azure DevOps *Approve with suggestions*) when publishing a review. Off by default so a pull request is never approved from VS Code by mistake. Only user settings count: a repository cannot turn it on.
config.defaultEngine: Engine preselected by **Review with AI**: `copilot` (GitHub Copilot in VS Code) or a key of `#smartPrReview.engines#`.
config.engines: Command-line AI engines. Each one gets the prompt on stdin, runs in a read-only worktree of the pull request and answers on stdout. The defaults keep Claude Code (restricted: no project hooks, settings or MCP servers), Codex and Cursor read-only and without web access; entries you add are merged with them. Machine-scoped: a repository cannot change it.
config.profilesPath: Folder of the repository with the review profiles (Markdown files with a `name` in their frontmatter).
config.aiLanguage: Language of the AI review comments and summary, for example `Spanish` or `English`. Empty: the language of the pull request title and description, or VS Code's display language when that is unclear.
config.aiTimeoutMinutes: Minutes an AI engine may take for one profile before it is stopped.
config.aiLabelComments: Add "Generated with AI · profile · engine" to the comments an AI review drafts.
welcome.noPullRequest:
No pull request is being reviewed. Pick one in **Pull Requests**, or search by number, title or author.
[Search Pull Requests](command:smartPrReview.searchPullRequests)
